title: Quectel 5G — Alternative (InfluxQL + live)
description: Live radio snapshot read from the router plus signal history from InfluxDB. Generated by quectel-5g-tools/grafana/generate_alternative.py.

targets.query: SELECT mean("rsrp") FROM "quectel_nr5g" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "band" fill(none)
SELECT mean("rsrp") FROM "quectel_lte" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "band" fill(none)
SELECT mean("sinr") FROM "quectel_nr5g" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "band" fill(none)
SELECT mean("sinr") FROM "quectel_lte" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "band" fill(none)
SELECT mean("rsrq") FROM "quectel_nr5g" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("rsrq") FROM "quectel_lte" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT last("rsrp") FROM "quectel_carrier_pcc", "quectel_carrier_scc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "role", "rat", "band" fill(none)
SELECT last("enodeb") FROM "quectel_lte" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT count("rsrp") FROM "quectel_neighbour" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "scope" fill(none)
SELECT count("rsrp") FROM "quectel_carrier_pcc", "quectel_carrier_scc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "rat" fill(none)
SELECT mean("frequency_mhz") FROM "quectel_carrier_pcc", "quectel_carrier_scc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "rat", "band" fill(none)
